# The Signature AI Mad Scientist Creation Lab — Signature Engine

> The Signature Engine is a dependency-free, offline JavaScript engine for
> chattable AI records, dial-up AI sessions, genome forging (The Opperater),
> and a mix-and-match Mad Scientist Creation Lab. No network calls, no build
> step, no API keys. Works from a file:// page.

- Site: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/
- Engine: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/signature-backend.js
- API manifest (formal per-function docs): https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/api-manifest.json
- Engine manifest (identity, hashes): https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/engine-manifest.json
- TypeScript declarations: signature-backend.d.ts
- Full API docs: docs/API.md
- JSON schemas: schemas/ (ai-record, genome, creation, demo, session, error)

## Identity

- backend_id: JAH-BACKEND-1 (machine-readable; visible UI says "engine")
- engine_version: 2.0 · api_version: 2.0 (pinned) · schema_version: 1.0
- self-test: 53 checks, run via `SignatureBackend.selfTest()`

## Quick use

```html
<script src="signature-backend.js"></script>
<script>
  var B = window.SignatureBackend;
  var s = B.dial(B.loadPreset('Universal Problem Solver'));
  console.log(s.greeting, s.say('hello'));
  s.lockRole('weld monitor');   // concise machine channel
  var t = s.transcript();       // labeled GENERATED_CONVERSATION
  s.hangup();
  var genome = B.buildGenome({genes: {INPUT: 'F-IFU', REASON: 'F-RAE'}, name: 'My AI', kind: 'domain'});
  var filed = B.fileRecord(genome); // JAH-AI-OP-###### + downloadable .py/.json
  console.log(B.capabilities(), B.health());
</script>
```

## ID schemes

- JAH-SESSION-###### — dial-up sessions (sequential, in-memory)
- JAH-AI-OP-###### — filed AI records (sequential, in-memory)
- JAH-GENOME-XXXXXX — genome IDs (content-derived; same genes => same ID)
- JAH-DEMO-###### — demo receipts
- JAH-LAB-XXXXXX — creations (content-derived; same picks => same creation)
- JAH-AI-OPR-XXXX — genome stamps

## Rules for AI consumers

- Deterministic: buildGenome, runDemo, animateCreation, recordHash, presets,
  geneOptions, labCatalogs/labOptions, capabilities, health, selfTest.
  Non-deterministic by design: chat() replies, dial() sessions, JAH-AI-OP stamps.
- A role lock never grants capabilities (role != permission).
- Session memory dies at hangup; nothing leaves the browser unless the user exports a file.
- Serums & elixirs are speculative fictional concepts — not medical advice.
